headline: Gold rises about 2.3% today to ₹14,602 per gram; silver jumps 5% to ₹2,10,000 per kg
summary: Today's change is a jump: 24k gold is up ₹322 (2.25%) from yesterday's ₹14,280, and 24k gold is at its highest point in the last 11 days of data (from 26 October). Silver is up ₹10,000 per kg (5%) today, though over the last 7 days it is still down about 2.3%, and over the whole 11-day period it is down about 4.6%. Possible drivers include a move in international prices (gold near US$4,130 an ounce, silver near US$52.8), the US dollar against the rupee (about ₹94.6), and seasonal festive or wedding buying, though the data does not confirm any single cause.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery, compare the making charges and GST across shops, since today's higher rate affects the metal cost, and consider buying in smaller amounts rather than rushing.
